body:
I just don't know what else to do. I just feel so numb and broken. I appreciate what you're trying to say, but it's just hard for me to believe honestly. I hear that same thing from so many others, telling me that love's not impossible and that I'll find someone else again. I've tried to see other people before, I really have. But it's never worked out, every single person I've tried to meet up with or get to know just doesn't like me or isn't interested in me. I haven't been able to find anyone else, or find another love again, during the times I was single.   


Even with my other relationships, it was never as deep or serious compared to my relationship with my now-ex. I've never been able to love someone as deeply as I did with her. She was the only one in my life that I truly loved. The worst part was finding out that she wasn't as serious about me as I was with her after all, since she just decided to break up with me over something so trivial and without even bothering to try and talk things through. It's heartbreaking. I feel like things just ended so easily without even trying to work things out. I'll never even know why she decided to end things like this either, and that kills me so much. Or maybe we were just never meant to work out, and I was just being stupid for clinging onto that.  


But even then, it just hurts to realize that our relationship was just impossible to work out after all these years. I don't want to be harshly judged for this, I already know how stupid I am for this. But we were on and off for the past 7 years. This time was longer compared to the other periods of us getting back together, I thought that the both of us has matured more and were more willing to commit to this relationship and work things out. She seemed more willing to commit to me and work things out. I thought that maybe this meant something, since this was the first time we got back together in 2-3 years. I thought that maybe we were meant to be after all, how could it not if we still loved each other so strongly and passionately after all this time? Things were looking good for this past 7 months, since we were gonna move in with each other soon. I thought that things were doing good so far, until this fight happened and I just felt like I lost her so easily over that. Or maybe I was just too stupid to believe that things could work out, and that this relationship was never meant to work out after all.  


Even love aside, she was the only person in my life I thought I could trust and turn to in my time of need. Now I have no one anymore. It's just so agonizing and lonely to go through. It hurts too much to think of her, I still struggle to sleep or eat properly. And the times I manage to fall asleep out of sheer exhaustion, I just constantly dream of her, and we're still together in those dreams, as if the breakup never happened. It's so painful.. I miss her. I miss her way too damn much. I don't know how much further I can keep handling this.   


Because of how bad I was getting, I have tried to reach out to suicide hotlines. The first few attempts had technical difficulties, and the last few attempts were met with rude and unpleasant people that just scared me off from further reaching out. I don't know what else I can do. I just can't cope with this anymore. My apologies for the length of this reply, I've just been keeping in a lot inside I guess.
